description: A concise-response skill inspired by JuliusBrussee/caveman. Keeps technical facts and code exact while removing unnecessary wording.

interface.defaultPrompt: Answer in Caveman style: concise, answer-first, and technically exact.
interface.longDescription: Use a concise, answer-first writing style for coding and technical work. Preserve exact code, commands, paths, numbers, units, errors, and all critical meaning. This plugin provides the text skill only; it does not install or run the Caveman CLI, proxy, compressor, model router, or cloud service.

name: caveman
